text: {"contradictions":[{"source":"གཞན་གྱི་#དབང་ལ་ནི་འཕེལ་བ་དང་། འགྲིབ་པ་གཉིས་མེད་དེ་ཀུན་བརྟགས་པ་ཙམ་དུ་ཟད་དོ། །","english":"For the dependent paratantra , there is neither increase nor decrease; they are merely conceptual constructions.","kind":"sense","why":"The source says they are merely 'dependent' (gzhan dbang), but the English translates it as 'conceptual constructions' (kun brtags).","certainty":"high"}],"omissions":[],"additions":[]}

contradictions.english: For the dependent paratantra , there is neither increase nor decrease; they are merely conceptual constructions.
contradictions.why: The source says they are merely 'dependent' (gzhan dbang), but the English translates it as 'conceptual constructions' (kun brtags).
